query: SELECT b.id, b.status, b.startDate, b.endDate, b.totalPrice, v.make, v.model, p.status as payment_status, p.stripeSessionId FROM bookings b JOIN vehicles v ON b.vehicleId = v.id LEFT JOIN payments p ON b.id = p.bookingId ORDER BY b.createdAt DESC LIMIT 5;
